author: Church Machine
description: Wukong board hardware ROM boot program. 73-instruction infinite loop: LED0 on → transmit "CM:WUKONG\r\n" over UART (busy-poll per byte) → ~0.498 s on-delay → LED0 off → ~0.498 s off-delay → repeat. No RETURN, no CALL. Runs safely on an unconfigured FPGA with no IDE connected. Recovered from git (deleted in lump-directory cleanup). Full disassembly confirmed word-for-word against the recovered binary.

capabilities.name: LED0
capabilities.note: CR3 — DWRITE word 0 = {B,G,R}; bit 0 = R (physical LED pin). On: DWRITE DR1,CR3,0,DR0. Off: DWRITE DR0,CR3,0,DR0.

capabilities.name: UART_TX
capabilities.note: CR4 — DWRITE word 0 = TX data byte; DREAD word 1 (offset=DR1=1) = STATUS, bit 0 = busy. Busy-poll: DREAD/ISUB/BRANCHEQ per byte.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: One-time capability loads and constant init. LOAD LED0→CR3 (c-list[0]), LOAD UART_TX→CR4 (c-list[1]), IADD DR1=1 (used as LED-on value and DREAD STATUS offset throughout).

methods.name: loop_top
methods.description: Infinite LED-on + UART banner phase. DWRITE DR1,CR3 (LED on). Then emits 11 bytes over UART with busy-poll per byte: 'C'(67) 'M'(77) ':'(58) 'W'(87) 'U'(85) 'K'(75) 'O'(79) 'N'(78) 'G'(71) CR(13) LF(10). Each byte: IADD DR5=#byte, DWRITE DR5,CR4, then poll: DREAD DR6,CR4,0,DR1 / ISUB DR7,DR6,#1 / BRANCHEQ poll_X.

methods.name: on_delay
methods.description: LED-on hold delay ~0.498 s at 50 MHz. Nested loop: outer=380, inner=16383. 380 × 16383 × 4 cycles = ~24.9M cycles. IADD DR3=#380 / outer_on: IADD DR2=#16383 / inner_on: ISUB DR2,DR2,#1 / BRANCHNE inner_on / ISUB DR3,DR3,#1 / BRANCHNE outer_on.

methods.name: led_off
methods.description: DWRITE DR0,CR3,0,DR0 — sets LED0 word 0 to 0 (off). DR0 is the zero register (never written).

methods.name: off_delay
methods.description: LED-off hold delay ~0.498 s at 50 MHz. Identical nested-loop structure to on_delay: outer=380, inner=16383.

methods.name: loop_back
methods.description: BRANCH AL [03] — unconditional branch back to loop_top (offset=-69). Closes the infinite loop.

clist_note: W0126=0x32000003, W0127=0x32000002 are v1.x Inform GTs (old NS-slot-addressed format, pre-v2.0). Stale from original compile. In modern use the lazy-loader overwrites these with live Abstract GTs at install time.
